s-1.ptxt: Install Exhaust Pipe Assembly Center

s2.ptxt: Compression Spring Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using a vernier caliper, measure the free length of the compression spring.

atten4.ptxt: If it is less than the minimum, replace the spring with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Install the gasket.

s3.ptxt: Insert a new gasket into the center pipe assembly by hand as far as it will go.
Place a piece of wood against the gasket and, using a hammer, gradually tap it in until it reaches the flange end face of the exhaust center pipe assembly.

item.ptxt: Do not install the gasket in the wrong direction.
Do not damage the outer surface of the gasket.
Do not reuse a gasket once it has been removed.
Never push in the gasket by installing the center exhaust pipe sub-assembly NO.2 without first pushing it in sufficiently by hand.

s2.ptxt: Install the exhaust center pipe assembly with 2 bolts and 2 compression springs.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that there is no significant difference in the clearance between the flanges of the exhaust center pipe assembly and the center exhaust pipe sub-assembly NO.2 at the front, rear, left and right.

Headlight Leveling Computer Assembly Initialization Procedure
Preparation for Headlight Aiming

item.ptxt: Perform the headlight aiming with the low beam.
When using a low beam tester, perform "Headlight Aiming Adjustment (Using Low Beam Tester)" and "Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using Low Beam Tester)".
If a low beam tester cannot be used, perform "Headlight Aiming Adjustment (Using Low Beam Screen)" and "Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using Low Beam Screen)".
For the high beam, perform "Headlight Aiming Adjustment (Using High Beam Tester)" and "Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using High Beam Tester)".
The adjustment procedure is shown using a 1m manual type headlight tester.

s2.ptxt: Adjust the tire pressure to the specified value.
Have 1 person sit in the driver seat.
Start the engine and keep the battery in a charging condition.
Set the leveling switch dial to 0. (Halogen type headlight)

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Aim Adjustment (Using Low Beam Tester)

s2.ptxt: Set the distance between the tester and the headlight lens to the tester's specified value.
Position the tester so that it squarely faces the vehicle.
Set up the headlight tester.

s3.ptxt: Set the angle adjustment knobs of the tester to 10cm downward and 0cm left/right.
Align the condenser lens of the tester with the center of the headlight.

s2.ptxt: Take measures so that the light from the other headlight does not affect the measurement.

item.ptxt: The outer lens of the headlight is made of resin, so it may be deformed by heat if the procedure takes a long time.
If covering it with an opaque object, do not keep it covered for more than 3 minutes.

s2.ptxt: Turn on the headlights on low beam.
Adjust the low beam aim according to the instruction manual of the headlight tester used.

atten3.ptxt: Adjust the aiming screw in the tightening direction (when adjusting in the loosening direction, loosen it once and then tighten it again).

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using Low Beam Tester)

s2.ptxt: After adjusting the aim, inspect the luminous intensity with the headlight tester.

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Aim Adjustment (Using Low Beam Screen)

s2.ptxt: Prepare a piece of thick white paper.
Prepare an aiming screen as shown in the illustration. (Discharge type headlight)
Prepare an aiming screen as shown in the illustration. (Halogen type headlight)
Set the distance between the tester and headlight lens to 3m.
Position the tester so that it squarely faces the vehicle.
Set up the headlight tester.

s3.ptxt: Align the center of the tester condenser lens with the headlight center.
Align the center hole of the adjustment screen with the center of the tester condenser lens, and attach it with tape or equivalent.

s2.ptxt: Turn on the headlights on low beam.
If it deviates significantly from the reference line, adjust the low beam aim so that the cut-off line aligns with the reference line.

atten3.ptxt: Adjust the aiming screw in the tightening direction (when adjusting in the loosening direction, loosen it once and then tighten it again).

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using Low Beam Screen)

s2.ptxt: Set the distance between the tester and the headlight lens to the tester's specified value.
Position the tester so that it squarely faces the vehicle.
Set up the headlight tester.

s3.ptxt: Set the angle adjustment knobs of the tester to 11cm downward and 23cm to the left.
Align the condenser lens of the tester with the center of the headlight.

s2.ptxt: Take measures so that the light from the other headlight does not affect the measurement.

item.ptxt: The outer lens of the headlight is made of resin, so it may be deformed by heat if the procedure takes a long time.
If covering it with an opaque object, do not keep it covered for more than 3 minutes.

s2.ptxt: Turn on the headlights on low beam.
After aiming adjustment, inspect with the headlight tester.

atten4.ptxt: For an automatic type tester, measure the luminous intensity at the point of maximum intensity.

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Aim Adjustment (Using High Beam Tester)

s2.ptxt: Set the distance between the tester and the headlight lens to the tester's specified value.
Position the tester so that it squarely faces the vehicle.
Set up the headlight tester.

s3.ptxt: Set the angle adjustment knobs of the tester to 1/5cm of the headlight center height downward and 0cm for both left and right. (LH headlight)
Set the angle adjustment knobs of the tester to 1/5cm of the headlight center height downward and 5cm to the left. (RH headlight)
Align the condenser lens of the tester with the headlight center.

s2.ptxt: Take measures so that the light from the other headlight does not affect the measurement.

item.ptxt: The outer lens of the headlight is made of resin, so it may be deformed by heat if the procedure takes a long time.
If covering it with an opaque object, do not keep it covered for more than 3 minutes.

s2.ptxt: Turn on the headlights with high beam.
Adjust the high beam aim according to the handling procedure of the headlight tester used.

atten3.ptxt: Adjust the aiming screw in the tightening direction. (When adjusting in the loosening direction, loosen it once and then tighten it again.

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using High Beam Tester)

s2.ptxt: After adjusting the aim, inspect the luminous intensity with the headlight tester.
